title: AI Staff Engineer
jobDescription:

About StavPay

StavPay is a SaaS platform that automates accounts payable workflows, payment processing, and financial operations for hedge funds, private equity firms, fund administrators, and family offices. The platform handles invoice capture, approval routing, vendor management, multi-entity accounting, and payment execution.

We are entering a new phase of product development: embedding AI and agentic capabilities directly into our platform to transform how financial operations teams work. This is the most important technical initiative at StavPay, and this role will lead it.

About the Role

We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own the architecture, design, and delivery of AI-powered and Agentic features across StavPay. This is not an ML research role - it is a product engineering role for someone who can take large language models, tool-use patterns, and agentic frameworks and ship them as reliable, production-grade features that financial operations teams depend on daily. This role works alongside Lead Engineers who run the engineering team s day-to-day delivery; the Staff Engineer owns architecture, patterns, and technical direction across both AI features and the broader platform.

You will define how AI is integrated into StavPay: which workflows become agentic, how models interact with our domain data, how we build trust and safety into autonomous financial operations, and how we evolve the platform architecture to support these capabilities at scale.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will work across the full stack - from prompt engineering and model orchestration to API design, data pipelines, and frontend integration - and collaborate closely with product, design, and domain experts to ship features that meaningfully change how our clients operate.

Tech Stack & Environment

You will work across the following stack. Deep expertise in every layer is not required - but you should be comfortable navigating a polyglot codebase and making architectural decisions that span these technologies.

Cloud

Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault)

Backend

existing platform services in C# (Core)/ .NET/ Python

Frontend

Angular / TypeScript

Database

SQL Server

Architecture

Containerized microservices (Docker, Azure Container Apps / AKS) and Azure App Services

DevOps

Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, repos, boards)

AI Tooling

Claude, Codex CLI and Cursor for agentic development workflows

Integrations

MCP servers, REST APIs, payment rails (NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT), accounting system APIs

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Architecture & System Design

  • Design and build the core agentic infrastructure for StavPay: agent orchestration, tool-use frameworks, memory/context management, and guardrails for autonomous financial workflows.

  • Define the architecture for how LLMs interact with StavPay s domain model: invoices/contracts/purchase orders, approvals, vendor records, payment instructions, payment orchestration, accounting entries - safely and reliably.

  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and integrations that expose StavPay s capabilities as tools for AI agents and external AI platforms used by our clients.

  • Design patterns for human-in-the-loop oversight, approval gates, and escalation paths in agentic financial workflows.

AI Feature Development

  • Lead development of AI-powered product features: intelligent invoice processing, automated approval routing, anomaly detection, natural-language querying of financial data, and predictive cash-flow analysis.

  • Build and iterate on prompt chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and multi-step agent workflows tailored to financial operations.

  • Implement evaluation frameworks: automated testing for AI outputs, regression detection, quality scoring, and production monitoring for model-driven features.

  • Own the integration layer between LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) and StavPay s backend-model selection, fallback strategies, cost optimization, and latency management.

Technical Leadership

  • Set technical direction for AI/agentic development across the engineering team. Write RFCs, architectural decision records, and technical specifications.

  • Mentor engineers on AI integration patterns, prompt engineering, evaluation methodology, and safe deployment of model-driven features.

  • Establish engineering standards for AI features: testing practices, monitoring, incident response, and responsible AI guidelines specific to financial data.

  • Drive build-vs-buy decisions for AI tooling, frameworks, and infrastructure. Evaluate emerging tools and frameworks and make pragmatic adoption recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with product management to identify high-value AI use cases, scope MVPs, and define success criteria grounded in client outcomes.

  • Work with the implementation team to understand client workflows and pain points that AI can address.

  • Collaborate with security and compliance to ensure AI features meet regulatory requirements for financial data handling, auditability, and data privacy.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building production systems at scale.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building AI/ML-powered product features, including at least 1+ year shipping LLM-powered or agentic features into production (not research prototypes, but shipped software that real users depend on).

  • Deep experience with LLM integration: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, RAG architecture, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and production operations.

  • Strong proficiency in Python. Working knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems, with strong written communication (RFCs, design docs, ADRs).

  • Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity - translating broad product goals into concrete technical plans and shipping iteratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or production integrations. Stavtar runs MCP-first agentic infrastructure, and this experience is one of the most differentiating signals for this role.

  • Experience with at least one modern AI/agent framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic tool use, OpenAI Assistants, or similar) and a clear-eyed view of their trade-offs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.

  • Comfort reading and integrating with C# / .NET services. You will design how AI features interact with the existing platform, but you will not be expected to build primarily in C#.

  • Domain experience in FinTech, payments, accounting automation, fund administration, or financial operations.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and a philosophy for how they change engineering workflows.

  • Background in building trust and safety systems for AI: content filtering, output validation, human-in-the-loop patterns, and audit logging for autonomous actions.

  • Experience with Azure cloud services, SQL Server, or Azure DevOps.

  • Familiarity with financial data formats and integrations: NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT, or accounting system APIs (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage).

  • Prior experience at a Staff/Principal level or as a founding/early engineer at a startup where you shaped technical direction.

What You Might Ship in the First Year

The specifics will depend on where you see the highest leverage, but examples of the kind of work we envision:

  • Agentic AP assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming invoices, match them to POs, and contracts, route for approval, flag anomalies, and draft payment instructions with human confirmation.

  • Agentic Contract assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming contracts, extract key terms and obligations as structured metadata, and route for human-in-the-loop review.

  • Natural-language financial queries - a conversational interface that lets controllers ask questions about payables, cash positions, and vendor history without building reports.

  • MCP integration layer - Build/Enhance MCP servers that expose StavPay s core capabilities to external AI tools, enabling clients to interact with StavPay from Claude, Copilot, or their own agentic systems.

  • Intelligent onboarding - AI-powered data extraction and mapping that accelerates client onboarding from weeks to days.

  • Evaluation and monitoring infrastructure - automated testing, quality scoring, and production observability for every AI-driven feature.

How We Measure Success

  1. Shipped AI features that clients actively use and that measurably reduce manual work in financial operations workflows.

  2. Reliable agentic systems - autonomous workflows that operate safely within defined guardrails, with low error rates and clear audit trails.

  3. Engineering velocity - the team ships AI features faster over time because of the infrastructure, patterns, and tooling you establish.

  4. Technical credibility - you are the person engineering, product, and leadership turn to for AI/agentic technical decisions, and your judgment is consistently sound.

  5. Team capability growth - engineers across the team are more effective at building AI-powered features because of your mentorship and the standards you set.

Why This Role Matters

Financial operations is one of the highest-value domains for AI, it is structured, repetitive, high-stakes, and ripe for intelligent automation. But building AI for finance requires more than model access. It requires deep product thinking, rigorous engineering, and respect for the fact that these systems move real money.

This role is the technical cornerstone of StavPay s AI strategy. You will not be bolting AI onto an existing product - you will be fundamentally reshaping how the product works, and how our clients work, by bringing agentic intelligence into every layer of financial operations.

If you want to build AI systems that matter, at a company where you can see the direct impact of your work on real businesses, this is the role.

Agentic AI Architect India Job Code 5037

Join Centric Consulting A Culture You ll Love
At Centric Consulting, weve cultivated a unique approach to business. Our business is built on three fundamental principles: Enjoy the people you work with, have fun, and do great work. These principles define our consulting model and have crafted one of the most vibrant cultures in the consulting industry celebrating individuals, collaboration, and lifelong friendships.

The reality: Youre architecting systems where intelligence is distributed across components that can think and adapt. Traditional patterns often dont apply. Youll be creating new approaches to system design while balancing flexibility with reliability.
In this role, you will:
  • Design composition patterns and registry systems that enable flexible agent orchestration across our AI agentic harness
  • Architect information flows, context management, and attention optimization across agent systems
  • Define and evolve reusable architectural patterns, frameworks, and best practices for common agent coordination needs across agentic systems
  • Design prompt rendering systems and progressive disclosure mechanisms
  • Balance system complexity with maintainability, debuggability, and token efficiency
  • Establish architectural standards and patterns for the broader development team
  • Design delegation patterns and multi-agent coordination protocols
Who You Are:
Must Have:
  • 8+ years experience systems architecture or platform engineering background
  • Experience designing complex, multi-component systems
  • Experience with Cloud deployments (Azure preferred)
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts and data flow patterns
  • Solid programming skills (Python preferred) and ability to work across the stack
  • Experience with system integration and API design
  • Track record of learning new technologies and applying them effectively
  • Familiarity with generative AI frameworks, concepts, and capabilities
Highly Valuable:
  • Experience with workflow orchestration or event-driven architectures
  • Background with microservices, containerization, or cloud-native patterns
  • Experience with agent evaluation techniques
  • Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability in complex systems
  • Experience with performance optimization and scalability challenges
Preferred Requirements:
  • Experience with agent frameworks or multi-agent systems
  • Background in platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Knowledge of specific business domains and their technical requirements
Cultural Fit:
  • Systems thinker: You naturally see how components interact, compose, and influence each other
  • Pragmatic: You balance ideal designs with practical constraints, token limits, and performance requirements
  • Collaborative: You work closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders
  • Adaptable: Youre comfortable with evolving requirements, emerging patterns, and rapid technology changes
  • Quality focused: You understand that architectural decisions have long-term consequences for maintainability and composability
  • Curious about AI: Youre excited to explore how intelligent, adaptive systems change traditional architecture patterns
What We Offer All Roles:
  • Cutting-edge work: Youll be helping define how businesses use AI agents
  • Learning environment: Continuous exposure to new technologies and approaches
  • Impact: Your work directly enables new capabilities for clients and internal teams
  • Growth: As the field matures, youll be positioned as an expert practitioner
  • Collaboration: Work with a small, highly skilled team where everyones contribution matters
The Reality Check
This is early-stage, rapidly evolving technology. Youll be:
  • Figuring out best practices as you go
  • Learning new tools and approaches constantly
  • Debugging problems that dont have Stack Overflow answers yet
  • Creating solutions that didnt exist before
If youre looking for established, well-documented processes, this isnt the right fit. If youre excited about being at the forefront of transformative technology, lets talk.

Kefilo is building a human transformation ecosystem focused on functional nutrition, preventive wellness, gut health and lifestyle redesign.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who can take ownership of the product design function at Kefilo and help design a simple, intuitive and scalable digital experience for our customers and internal teams.

The role will involve understanding customer problems, designing user journeys, building the app experience, creating design systems and working closely with the founder, developers, nutritionists and operations team to turn business and customer requirements into a strong product.

  • Design intuitive mobile and web experiences for customers, nutritionists, operations and internal teams.

  • Design user journeys for meal subscriptions, personalized nutrition, transformation programs, assessments, progress tracking and customer engagement.

  • Convert complex nutrition and wellness information into simple and easy-to-understand user experiences.

  • Conduct user research, competitor analysis and usability testing to identify customer needs and product improvements.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes using Figma or similar tools.

  • Develop and maintain a consistent design system, component library and product design guidelines.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with nutritionists, food scientists, marketing and operations teams to understand requirements and translate them into product experiences.

  • Design dashboards and internal tools for customer management, subscriptions, nutrition, kitchen operations and business analytics.

  • Design data visualizations and progress-tracking interfaces that help customers understand their transformation journey.

  • Continuously analyse user feedback, product behaviour and usability issues and improve the product accordingly.

  • Explore how AI and personalization can be incorporated into the customer experience.

  • Help establish the overall visual language, interaction principles and digital brand experience for Kefilo.

Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in product design, UX/UI design or digital product development.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and modern product design tools.

  • Strong understanding of UX research, information architecture, user flows, interaction design and visual design.

  • Experience designing mobile-first products and responsive web applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating real-world digital products and end-to-end design processes.

  • Ability to simplify complex information and create intuitive user experiences.

  • Experience with consumer apps, D2C, health-tech, wellness, food-tech or subscription products is an advantage.

  • Understanding of design systems and developer handoff.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in an early-stage startup.

  • Interest in nutrition, wellness, technology, AI and consumer products is an advantage.

What You Get

  • Founding Senior Product Designer position at Kefilo.

  • Equity participation.

  • Direct collaboration with the founder and multidisciplinary founding team.

  • Opportunity to shape Kefilos digital product and customer experience from the ground up.

  • Ownership of the product design system and overall digital experience.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of food, nutrition, wellness, technology and transformation.

Important

This is an equity-only opportunity with no fixed salary at the current stage.

jobDescription:
AI-Native Backend & Data Automation Engineer Python

Experience: 25 years
Location: 100% remote, anywhere in India
CTC: Up to 6,00,000 per annum
Workday: Starts at 8:30 AM IST
Education: B.Tech degree mandatory

Please read before applying

This role has five non-negotiable requirements:

  1. The maximum CTC is 6 LPA. This is a firm ceiling. If your expected CTC is above 6 LPA, please do not applyyou will waste your time and ours.
  2. You must have 25 years of hands-on software development experience. This is not a fresher or trainee position.
  3. You must be strong in Python, SQL, backend development and data automation.
  4. Your workday must begin at 8:30 AM IST. You must also be available for occasional evening meetings with US stakeholders.
  5. Shortlisted candidates must complete a short technical exercise and provide a recorded walkthrough of software they have personally built.

If you meet all five requirements, please continue reading.


About Spice Profile

Spice Profile LLC is a US-based ecommerce company selling high-quality organic spices and herbs.

We have team members in India, Australia and the United States. We operate with a high standard of integrity and exist to give customers organic ingredients whose quality and authenticity they can trust.

We are building AI-native internal software products to automate complex business processes and help our team make faster, better and more reliable decisions.


About the role

We are hiring a backend and data automation engineer who can independently turn complicated business requirements into reliable production software.

You will build systems that collect data from different sources, apply explainable business rules, automate recurring decisions and give human operators clear visibility into what happened and why.

This is not a prompt-engineering, no-code or prototype-only position. You must be able to build and maintain real software involving APIs, databases, scheduled jobs, data pipelines, queues, tests, monitoring and failure recovery.

You will use AI coding agents extensively, but you will remain responsible for the architecture, security and correctness of everything you ship.


What you will be expected to deliver

  • Convert ambiguous business processes into clear technical requirements and working software.
  • Build reliable backend services, APIs, data pipelines and scheduled workers.
  • Combine operational and analytical data from multiple external systems.
  • Design deterministic rule and decision engines whose outputs can be explained and reproduced.
  • Build safeguards that prevent incorrect or stale data from triggering unsafe actions.
  • Implement queues, retries, idempotency, reconciliation and complete audit histories.
  • Model operational data in PostgreSQL and analytical data in BigQuery or a similar warehouse.
  • Build internal dashboards or lightweight interfaces when required.
  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot and maintain the systems you build.
  • Document important architecture, data models and operating procedures.
  • Build multiple internal automation productsnot only one application.

The systems you may work on

  • Third-party API and data-provider integrations.
  • High-volume analytical data and complex SQL transformations.
  • Hourly and daily background jobs.
  • Rule hierarchies, overrides and conflict detection.
  • Immutable event and decision records.
  • Data-freshness validation and circuit breakers.
  • Transactional state, concurrency controls and idempotent actions.
  • Dashboards for configuration, monitoring and exception handling.
  • AI-assisted investigation and operational workflows.
  • Production alerts, failed jobs and incomplete or contradictory data.

You do not need prior experience in our specific business domain. You do need the engineering discipline to learn it and represent it correctly in software.


Mandatory requirements

  • 25 years of professional software development experience.
  • A completed B.Tech degree.
  • Strong Python development skills.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another production relational database.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience building scheduled jobs, workers or asynchronous processing systems.
  • Ability to design clean data models and maintain data integrity.
  • Experience with automated testing, debugging, Git and code reviews.
  • Familiarity with Docker and at least one cloud platform.
  • Experience deploying or maintaining production software.
  • Regular use of AI coding tools or agents.
  • Ability to independently review and verify AI-generated code.
  • Clear written communication and willingness to disclose blockers early.
  • Ability to begin work at 8:30 AM IST and attend occasional later meetings.

Good to have

  • BigQuery and analytical data modelling.
  • Google Cloud services such as Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks or Cloud Scheduler.
  • TypeScript or Node.js.
  • React or Next.js for internal dashboards.
  • ETL or ELT pipelines and data-quality monitoring.
  • Workflow or configurable rule-engine development.
  • Ecommerce, marketplace or advertising API integrations.
  • MCP, structured LLM outputs, tool calling or agent evaluation.
  • OpenTelemetry, structured logging and production alerting.
  • Experience working with distributed or international teams.

What AI-native means to us

You should already be able to use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar coding agents to:

  • Break a large feature into well-scoped implementation tasks.
  • Give an agent relevant context, constraints and acceptance criteria.
  • Explore unfamiliar APIs and existing codebases.
  • Generate and improve tests, documentation and debugging plans.
  • Review generated code for incorrect assumptions, security issues and maintainability.
  • Verify results using tests, logs, database inspection and reproducible checks.
  • Maintain a coherent architecture while working at AI-assisted speed.

Occasionally asking ChatGPT for isolated code snippets does not make someone AI-native.

You must be able to explain every important part of the code you submit. The AI generated it is not an acceptable explanation.


You will probably succeed if

  • You enjoy understanding complicated business processes.
  • You think about edge cases before they become production incidents.
  • You prefer explainable systems over clever but unpredictable automation.
  • You can work independently without requiring constant task-by-task supervision.
  • You are comfortable saying that the available data is insufficient.
  • You take ownership after deployment instead of considering the job finished when the code is merged.
  • You investigate root causes rather than repeatedly applying temporary fixes.
  • You can move between backend engineering, data work and lightweight internal interfaces.

This role is not suitable for you if

  • You are a fresher or require extensive day-to-day technical hand-holding.
  • Your expected CTC is above 6 LPA.
  • Your experience is limited to tutorials, college projects or no-code tools.
  • You can build demos but have not maintained production software.
  • You accept AI-generated code without understanding and testing it.
  • You want to work only on isolated tickets with fully specified requirements.
  • You are unwilling to investigate failed jobs, incorrect data or production issues.
  • You cannot consistently begin your workday at 8:30 AM IST.

Express application method

We get thousands of applications for our job postings and can take time to go through them. If you would like to get to the front of the queue, directly email a Loom video walkthrough along with your resume to hr@spiceprofile.com. If you don't send a video link, your resume just gets sent to the back of the queue.

What to cover in your recorded walkthrough

  • The problem the system solved.
  • Which parts you personally designed and implemented.
  • The architecture and technology choices.
  • How data moved through the system.
  • How failures, retries and incorrect inputs were handled.
  • How the system was tested and monitored.
  • What you would improve if rebuilding it today.

A polished production is unnecessary. A simple screen recording with your voice is sufficient. We care about ownership and technical understanding.


Selection process

  1. Application questionnaire and eligibility screening.
  2. Review of the recorded project walkthrough.
  3. A short, unpaid, time-boxed technical exercise using fictional data.
  4. Code and architecture walkthrough with our team.
  5. Final discussion.

The exercise will assess backend design, APIs, SQL, deterministic business rules, testing and responsible use of AI. It will not involve algorithm puzzles or unpaid work on a live Spice Profile product.

AI tools may be used during the exercise. Candidates must disclose how they used them and must be able to explain and defend the submitted solution.

jobDescription:
Core AI Engineer Specialist

Experience: 7+ years

Location: Remote


Role Overview:

Experience req can be 7+ years with hands-on work in the pre-transformer era - people who have built models from scratch before 2017 and not just fine-tuned existing models. Good understanding of classical ML/DL algorithms and maths behind it.


We value what you have built over where you studied. A GitHub history, a Kaggle record, merged pull requests to a training library, a paper you reimplemented and evaluated properly all of these count for more with us than the name on your degree. If your CV is thin and your repositories are not, apply anyway. We read the repositories first.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Build models from scratch architectures, training loops, custom losses, data pipelines in PyTorch , not in a wrapper.
  • Post-train language models: supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation under a real capacity gap, PEFT, and RL from preferences or verifiable rewards.
  • Implement papers end to end, from an arXiv PDF to working code, and evaluate them rigorously enough that we can act on the result including when it is negative.
  • Adapt general models to specific domains without destroying what they already knew.
  • Cut GPU cost parallelism placement, memory, quantisation, serving-time arithmetic and measure the saving rather than asserting it.
  • Track the field and adopt what is worth adopting, quickly, and tell us what is not.

What we require:

  • Deep learning fundamentals. Backpropagation, optimisation and transformer architectures attention, tokenisation, embeddings understood mechanically, not as vocabulary. You should be able to explain why attention is scaled by 1/d, what a normalisation layer does to gradient flow, and what actually happens in an optimiser step.
  • Hands-on PyTorch or Keras. You build and train models from scratch — not fine-tuning through an API, not Trainer with a config file.
  • LLM post-training, in practice — SFT (data construction, packing, masking, and what goes wrong); knowledge distillation (forward vs reverse KL, on-policy distillation, capacity gaps); PEFT ( LoRA and QLoRA , quantisation, adapter placement and rank selection); RLHF and its descendants — DPO, GRPO, PPO, RLOO : what each optimises and how each fails.
  • Engineering. Solid Python . CUDA and GPU-training basics — what is actually running on the device, and why your step time is what it is. Distributed training (DDP / FSDP) is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Proven ability to implement papers end to end — arXiv to working code — and to evaluate rigorously. Rigorous means seeds, baselines, controls and an honest statement of the noise floor.
  • Speed of adoption. This field moves faster than any curriculum. We need people who read, try, discard and keep the residue — and who can tell the difference between a real advance and a well-marketed one.

Mandatory Tech Stack:

  • Languages: Python, C++, CUDA
  • Deep Learning: PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy
  • LLM / Transformers: Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, Tokenizers
  • Fine-tuning & Post-training: PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, GRPO, PPO, RLOO, Knowledge Distillation
  • Training: DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, Mixed Precision, Gradient Checkpointing
  • GPU & Performance: CUDA, NVIDIA GPUs, GPU Profiling, Quantisation, Memory & Compute Optimisation
  • Inference & Serving: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM
  • Data & Experimentation: Hugging Face Datasets, Pandas, Weights & Biases / MLflow
  • Engineering: Linux, Git, GitHub, Docker

Core stack: Python + PyTorch + CUDA + Transformers/TRL + PEFT + LLM Post-training + Distributed Training + GPU Optimisation + vLLM.

title: AI Solutions Analyst
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Analyst

Mumbai Office


About the job

At Nouryon, our global team of changemakers takes positive action every day, to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.

The AI Solutions Analyst is a developer on Nouryon's AI invoice intelligence platform an application that reads supplier invoices and extracts charge-level detail to give the business full transparency into logistics cost. This role owns the end-to-end onboarding of vendors onto the platform analysing each vendor's invoice format, engineering the AI instructions that teach the system to read it correctly, and validating extraction quality until it can be trusted. This role is the connective tissue between the digital transformation team, logistics and procurement stakeholders, and the data that drives cost-leakage decisions — ensuring that AI-extracted invoice data translates into measurable savings, organisational transparency, and continuous improvement.


Job Description

The role is centered around the following core pillars:

  • AI Prompt Engineering – Design, tune and test the natural-language instructions that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoice format accurately.
  • Vendor Onboarding – Own the end-to-end onboarding of new vendors onto the platform, from first sample invoice to live, validated extraction.
  • Data Analytics – Serve as the analytical engine of the team by measuring extraction accuracy, error patterns, and AI processing cost, and translating findings into targeted improvements.
  • Data Quality Assurance – Validate AI output against source documents and safeguard the integrity of the invoice data reaching the business.
  • Stakeholder Management – Coordinate with the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors to align formats, priorities and expectations.
  • Process Improvements – Identify and deploy improvements in onboarding, extraction, and quality-assurance workflows.

Job Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding & Format Analysis

  • Collect and analyse representative sample invoices from new vendors across warehouse, ocean freight, road/rail, and customs brokerage modes.
  • Identify each vendor's invoice structure, charge-line conventions, and formatting quirks that affect automated extraction.
  • Onboard vendors onto the platform, configuring extraction profiles and routing settings per vendor.
  • Own a named portfolio of vendors end-to-end, from onboarding through to sustained extraction quality.

AI Prompt Engineering & Model Training

  • Design, write and iterate custom extraction prompts that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoices correctly.
  • Test prompt changes against curated reference sets before releasing them to production.
  • Diagnose extraction failures to root cause and resolve them at the prompt level, permanently rather than case by case.
  • Continuously improve extraction accuracy and reduce AI processing cost per invoice.

Validation & Data Quality

  • Validate AI-extracted charge lines, invoice metadata and classifications against source documents until extraction holds reliably.
  • Approve, correct or reject extracted data, ensuring only verified information reaches downstream reporting.
  • Curate golden test sets from verified invoices to support regression testing.
  • Safeguard data quality, completeness and consistency across the vendor portfolio.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Measure and report extraction accuracy, first-pass approval rate, and AI cost per invoice for owned vendors.
  • Analyse error patterns across vendors, modes and document types to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the programme team and senior stakeholders.
  • Prepare periodic performance reporting for leadership.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement

  • Act as a key interface between the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors on onboarding and extraction topics.
  • Escalate invoice formats or system limitations that require platform-level changes, with a recommended course of action.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across onboarding, prompt engineering, and quality-assurance workflows.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics, reporting, and decision-support tooling.

We believe you bring (Education & Experience)

This is a specific profile. We are not looking for a generalist analyst — we are looking for someone who has built AI solutions in the field, against real data, with users watching.

1. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) experience
You have worked embedded with a business function, not behind a ticket queue. You have taken an ambiguous operational problem, built a working solution against real data, and iterated it in front of the people who use it. You are comfortable when requirements arrive as a conversation rather than a specification.

2. Prompting
You have built something with an LLM that worked measurably better on Friday than it did on Monday — and you can explain exactly why. You treat prompts as engineered artefacts: versioned, tested against a reference set, and improved against a number. Experience with structured extraction from documents is a strong advantage.

3. Scrum
You have delivered in sprints — planning, stand-up, demo, retro — in a self-organising team. This team has no team lead: you will pick up work from a prioritised backlog, commit to it, and be accountable for it without being assigned it.

4. SQL and Python (pandas)
Intermediate SQL: joins, aggregations, grouping, window functions. Python at pandas level, sufficient to analyse extraction results offline, compare model outputs across runs, and quantify accuracy. You use data to prove an improvement, not to describe it.

5. Structured problem decomposition
You turn "this vendor extracts badly" into a specific, testable hypothesis, a defined check, and a fix that holds. You look for the systematic cause behind a single error rather than correcting the symptom.

6. Analytical rigour on documents
You can find one wrong figure in a forty-line charge table — and you are still finding it at four in the afternoon. Sustained precision over high volumes of detailed document work is the daily craft of this role.


Nice to have

  • Domain exposure — finance, procurement, logistics or supply chain; invoices, freight, warehousing, customs (Invoice processing, Accounts Payable)
  • Data annotation, labelling or data-quality operations background
  • Palantir Foundry experience
  • Statistical or ML modelling depth beyond descriptive analytics
  • BI tooling — Power BI, Tableau
  • Scrum certification — CSM / PSM
  • Version control — Git fundamentals
  • Experience supporting European stakeholders from an offshore or captive centre

Education & Experience

jobDescription:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

  • Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
  • Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk
  • Translate ambiguous, high-complexity implementation processes into robust system logic and reusable AI patterns; stay current with advances in agentic systems and translate research into practical engineering decisions

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated depth building and shipping production agentic AI systems — we weigh shipped systems over years in a title
  • Strong, hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks, including custom orchestration
  • Deep proficiency in Python — clean, testable, production-ready code
  • Experience designing and optimising end-to-end RAG systems: indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and evaluation
  • Daily working proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API) and Claude Code — you use these tools every day, not occasionally
  • Experience building and deploying agents on Azure AI Foundry or an equivalent enterprise cloud AI platform
  • Practical understanding of LLM behaviour — strengths, limitations, hallucination risks, reasoning constraints, and the evaluation methods used to measure them
  • Experience evaluating and debugging agent behaviour at trajectory and task level, not just output quality
  • Hands-on experience with MCP-based interoperability patterns and tool-calling agent design
  • Modern software practices: testing, CI/CD, observability, tracing, and debugging for LLM-based systems in production

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration and agent collaboration patterns
  • Familiarity with vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch
  • Experience building agents that process complex, unstructured document types — contracts, RFPs, configuration files, regulatory documents
  • Exposure to model adaptation techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA
  • Prior work in insurance, financial services, or enterprise SaaS implementation environments
  • Demonstrated habit of staying current with AI research, benchmarks, and emerging engineering patterns

title: System Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30,000 webpages. It is an integrated platform offering a portfolio of products covering payments, cards, wallets, loans, deposits, mutual funds, and loans on lifestyle products, ranging from consumer durables to home furnishings. The Software Development Manager (SDM) - Full Stack leads a single POD of 5-7 developers building the experience and services layer of this platform on Next.js, React and Node JS. Reporting to the Technical Architect - Frontend, the role converts approved architecture and design system standards into production-grade full stack implementations - server rendered and statically generated pages, shared components, BFF and API integration layers - and is accountable for the POD's delivery predictability, Core Web Vitals, code quality and compliance posture. The role is expected to remain hands-on, conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards and SOPs, and continuously raise the productivity of the POD through automation and AI-assisted engineering.
Responsibilities
  • Data Privacy and Security: Ensure all development within the POD complies with applicable data privacy regulation, RBI and internal information security policy, including data localisation requirements for any cloud or AI service used.
  • Secure SDLC: Enforce secure coding practices covering the OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply chain scanning, secrets management, and timely closure of VAPT and application security findings.
  • Browser and Client Security: Ensure correct implementation of CSP, XSS and CSRF protection, secure token and session handling in the browser, and governance of third-party scripts and tags on the POD's surfaces.
  • Audit Readiness: Maintain traceability from requirement to code to release - approvals, change records, test evidence and deployment records - so that internal audit and regulatory reviews can be served without rework.
  • Incident Management: Own the POD's participation in production incident response, root cause analysis and preventive action tracking, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Execute POCs to validate frameworks, rendering approaches and migration paths with clear benchmarking on performance, cost and scalability before adoption.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Drive adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering within the POD - code generation, review assistance, test generation and design-to-code workflows - with measurable impact on velocity and quality and with clear guardrails on data, IP and security.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Support the migration of the existing CMS rendered estate to a composable Next.js frontend for the POD's scope, ensuring zero regression on organic traffic, analytics and compliance sensitive journeys.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Leverage and sponsor innovation work through internal incubators and the external start-up network to introduce novel technical capabilities into the platform.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Maintain a technical debt and dependency upgrade register for the POD's codebase with an agreed remediation plan, including supply chain risk across the dependency tree.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Establish frontend observability for the POD - real user monitoring, synthetic checks and error tracking through New Relic, Datadog and Lighthouse CI - and act on the telemetry.
  • POD and Team Management: Technical Mentorship: Provide day to day technical guidance to 5-7 developers, run design and code walkthroughs, and build depth in the POD through structured learning paths and pair programming.
  • POD and Team Management: Performance Management: Set clear, measurable goals for every team member, conduct regular one-on-ones and reviews, give constructive feedback, and close the appraisal cycle within timelines.
  • POD and Team Management: Capacity and Resource Planning: Allocate work across the POD based on story complexity, skill fit and individual development needs, maintain sprint velocity and utilisation, and flag capacity risks to the Technical Architect early.
  • POD and Team Management: Talent Acquisition and Retention: Participate in hiring panels, own the technical evaluation of candidates for the POD, and run structured onboarding and ramp-up plans for new joiners, byte hires and partner resources.
  • POD and Team Management: Partner Management: Manage in-POD vendor and partner developers to the same standard of quality, hygiene and delivery discipline as internal engineers.
  • POD and Team Management: Team Collaboration: Build a cohesive POD with strong communication into Product, Design, Content, QA and infrastructure teams, and maintain high engagement and morale.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own end-to-end delivery for the POD - sprint planning, estimation, build, code review, testing, release and post-release stabilisation - for all web and in-app surfaces in scope.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Translate the solution design provided by the Technical Architect into implementable low-level designs, component specifications, API and data contracts, and task breakdowns for the POD.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Remain hands-on for a meaningful share of the role (target 30-40%) on Next.js and React development with TypeScript, including App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, ISR and streaming.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own the POD's Node JS services and BFF layer - route handlers, API aggregation, GraphQL and REST consumption, caching, resilience patterns, timeouts and error handling.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Consume and contribute to the enterprise design system and shared component library, ensuring token, theming, versioning and Storybook discipline rather than local forks and one-off components.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Implement integration with headless content sources (AEM headless or other CMS/DXP), commerce and backend services through the contract layer defined by the Architect.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own state management, data fetching and form and validation architecture within the POD's applications, keeping patterns consistent with the platform standard.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own edge and caching behaviour for the POD's routes in partnership with CDN teams - cache key design, revalidation, purge strategy and origin protection across Akamai and Cloudflare.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Drive release readiness through build checklists, feature flag and progressive rollout plans, deployment runbooks, rollback plans and production hypercare for every deployment.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Ensure the POD's digital assets continue to perform through peak sales season by designing for auto-scale, graceful degradation and resilient rendering across the Node / SSR tier, CDN and origin.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, peer review, merge and promotion discipline across the POD using Git, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and monorepo and package governance conventions.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own quality gates - SonarQube, static analysis, code coverage, bundle size checks, Lighthouse CI budgets and automated security scanning - and hold the line on defect density and escaped defects.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own the POD's Core Web Vitals outcomes (LCP, INP, CLS) including bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font strategy, hydration cost, streaming and partial prerendering, with explicit optimisation for low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks and in-app webviews.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Ensure testing coverage across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers using Jest, Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, along with visual regression, before any release is certified.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own SEO, GEO, structured data, render parity and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) as build-time concerns for the POD rather than post-release corrections.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Low-level design and component design decisions within the boundaries of the architecture and design system standards approved by the Technical Architect.
  • Rendering mode selection per route - SSR, SSG, ISR or client rendering - within the strategy defined by the Architect.
  • Implementation approach for BFF and API integration, state management, error handling and resilience patterns for the POD's scope.
  • Sprint scope, story sequencing, estimation and allocation of work across the 5-7 developers in the POD

At Impressico, the Personal Assistant to the Technical Director exists to protect the Director s time and attention so that it is spent on the highest-value technical and strategic work.   • Draft, review and manage email and documents on the Director s behalf - triage the inbox, flag what needs attention, prepare replies for approval, and produce clean, well-formatted decks, reports, trackers and meeting notes
  • Schedule meetings and working sessions across internal leadership, delivery teams, clients and vendors, including across time zones, and ensure invites, agendas, rooms and conferencing links are correct
  • Compile and circulate recurring reports and status updates to leadership, initiative stakeholders and clients to agreed timelines, chasing inputs from contributors where required
  • Arrange all travel and logistics for the Director and, where required, family - air, rail and hotel bookings, visas, cabs, itineraries, expense claims and reimbursements - and re-plan quickly when arrangements change at short notice

title: Sr Security Engineer - Course Creator (Content Engineering)
jobDescription:
Senior Security Engineer Course Creator (Content Engineering) at Practical DevSecOps

Location: Hyderabad (preferred, hybrid) remote considered for exceptional candidates

About the role
Practical DevSecOps is the training partner behind 10 hands-on certifications CDP, CDE, CCSE, CCNSE, CAISP, CMCPSE, CTMP, CASP, CSSE and CSC used by 12,500+ security professionals and teams at IBM, Accenture, PwC, Booz Allen Hamilton, Standard Chartered and PayPal. Our courses are browser-based labs, not slideware, and our exams are 6 hour hands-on challenges with written reports.
We are hiring a Course Creator to design and build that content. This is a builders role: you will own courses end to end curriculum, labs, lab infrastructure, video lessons, exam challenges and grading rubrics for topics at the front edge of DevSecOps, AI security and cloud-native security.
If you have ever finished a security course and thought "I could have taught this better, and with real labs," this is that job.


What you will do
Build courses
  • Own new and existing courses end to end: learning outcomes, module structure, lesson scripting, hands-on labs and assessments.
  • Design lab exercises that force learners to do the work build the pipeline, break the model, harden the cluster not watch someone else do it.
  • Record and script video lessons, write technical guides, checklists and reference material.
  • Design exam challenges and the grading rubrics that go with them, and support exam evaluation.
Research and stay ahead
  • Research emerging technologies and turn them into teachable lab scenarios AI/LLM security, MCP servers and agentic AI, supply chain security, Kubernetes, zero trust.
  • Attack and defend AI models, inference endpoints and MCP servers; translate those findings into lessons.
  • Keep the existing catalogue current as tools, CVEs and frameworks move (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, SLSA, CIS benchmarks, ASVS).
Build the platform around the content
  • Build and maintain the lab infrastructure so learners can focus on the skill, not the setup.
  • Build internal tooling that shortens the time from idea to shipped lesson.
  • Look for ways to scale and streamline how content gets produced and reviewed.
Support learners
  • Be a visible, responsive presence in support forums and the Mattermost community.
  • Turn recurring learner questions into better content.


What we are looking for
Must have
  • 5+ years in application security, product security or DevSecOps roles.
  • Strong hands-on depth in at least two of: CI/CD security (SCA, SAST, DAST, secrets), container and Kubernetes security, IaC/CaC (Terraform, Ansible, Inspec), AI/LLM security, API security, threat modeling, software supply chain security.
  • Working fluency with Docker, Git, and at least one CI system (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI).
  • Scripting and automation in Python, Bash or Go enough to build labs, not just run tools.
  • Genuinely good technical writing. You can explain a hard concept to a mid-level engineer in plain English and make them want to try it.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed team with minimal supervision.
Nice to have
  • Prior experience creating training content, courseware, workshops or conference trainings.
  • A public body of work: blog, CTF challenges, open-source tooling, conference talks (Black Hat, OWASP AppSec, BSides, DevSecCon), CVEs.
  • Experience with LLM tooling and frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, vector stores, agent frameworks) from a security perspective.
  • Video production or screencast experience.
What we are not looking for
  • Someone who has only run scanners and triaged tickets.
  • Someone who needs a full spec before starting.


Perks
  • Apple/Mac stack (MBP, Keynote).
  • Highly competitive compensation.
  • Flexible work schedule; hybrid from our Hyderabad office, or fully remote for the right person.
  • Free access to every Practical DevSecOps certification, plus a budget for conferences and training.
  • Time explicitly allocated for research staying current is the job, not something you do after hours.

Each service domain is led by a Service Owner, accountable for service delivery, continuous improvement, and lifecycle management in close alignment with Product Owners and business stakeholders.

Role Overview

The SAP SCM Consultant / Business Analyst will be a key member of the Core ERP (Digital Services) in-house team, responsible for managing and improving SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) solutions across the enterprise. This role bridges functional consulting, business analysis, and AMS coordination, ensuring operational excellence while enabling strategic improvement initiatives.

The consultant will initially work on the existing ECC landscape, supporting ongoing operations, AMS activities, and continuous improvement. Over the coming years, as the organization transitions to FORCE S/4HANA, the role will evolve to support the phased migration from ECC to S/4HANA - ensuring smooth template transition, data readiness, and alignment of business processes across both platforms.

Reporting to the Service Owner, the consultant will act as the functional and technical liaison between internal teams and the AMS partner, driving high-quality service delivery while promoting automation, innovation, and operational excellence. jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Manager - Global Accounting, Consolidation Reporting to own the month-end close, multi-entity consolidation, and reporting for a fast-growing consumer and technology company operating across 8+ legal entities (US, India, UK, Canada, China, Hong Kong, and 4 new EU entities launching soon).

This role reports to the Director of Accounting and manages a team of 4 (Sheeba, Saurabh, and 2 new hires - Sr GL Analyst and FA Analyst). You will own the T+3 soft / T+6 hard / T+7 reporting close cadence, group consolidation, forex restatement, payroll accounting, intercompany, equity accounting (SBC/ESOPs), and audit coordination with Deloitte (US) and local firms.

The ideal candidate is a qualified Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of post-qualification experience running global US GAAP close, comfortable owning technical accounting judgments, and ready to build accounting maturity as the company scales into new geographies.

You will work closely with the Finance Controller, VP Accounting (US), FPA, Payroll Director, Tax Lead, and external auditors.

Success in this role means an on-time, accurate close every month across all entities, clean audits, strong internal financial controls, and a team that grows with you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the global month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cadence: T+3 soft / T+6 hard / T+7 reporting across all 11+ entities.
  • Own multi-entity consolidation and elimination entries, including forex restatement across 8+ base currencies (USD, INR, GBP, CAD, CNY, HKD, EUR).
  • Own intercompany transactions between US parent and all subsidiaries, including cross-entity postings, netting, and transfer pricing entries in coordination with the Tax Lead.
  • Own Fixed Assets accounting (across all entities) until the FA Analyst is hired; then transition to review-only.
  • Own end-to-end statutory and regulatory compliance for the accounting function across three regions - Europe (UK + Germany, Spain, Netherlands, France) - including books-and-records compliance, statutory filings, statutory audits, and coordination with local consultants and regulators. Partner with the Tax Lead on tax-specific filings.
  • Lead the annual audit with local audit firms across 6+ geographies. Own PBC lists, coordination, and audit deliverables.
  • Own all payroll accounting reconciliations across geographies (13+ recurring recs: Salaries, Bonus, PF, ESI, PT, Medical, Dental, Vision, Withholding, Gratuity, Leave Encashment, NPS, Commissions).
  • Manage a team of 3-4 direct reports.
  • Drive process improvements in close, consolidation, and reporting - reduce close timeline, improve accuracy, automate wherever possible.

Requirements

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) with 8-10 years of post-qualification experience.
  • At least 4-5 years managing a global accounting team in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  • Deep, hands-on US GAAP expertise (ASC 606, ASC 842, SBC, consolidation, revenue recognition).
  • Experience with NetSuite (OneWorld, Multi-Book) is required. Working knowledge of Coupa (AP), Numeric (close management), Avalara (tax), Carta (equity) is a strong plus.
  • Experience owning close + consolidation across 5+ legal entities and multiple base currencies.
  • Big 4 background (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) preferred. Prior experience at a fast-growing consumer or tech company preferred.
  • Hands-on experience managing statutory and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions (US, India, Europe). Familiarity with US GAAP and local GAAPs (Ind AS, F/ IFRS for UK, EU-country local GAAPs).
  • Working knowledge of India tax regimes (GST, TDS, corporate tax), US sales tax + federal filings, and EU VAT / intra-EU compliance strongly preferred.
  • Strong people leadership skills; ability to coach analysts and grow a team.
  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and stakeholder management (US-based leadership + external auditors).
  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment with expanding geographic footprint (EU launch imminent).

Why This Role Exists

Jira Service Management has evolved into a critical enterprise platform supporting IT Asset Management, Vulnerability Management, Incident Management, Change Management, and key operational workflows. Recent regulatory examinations and our cybersecurity program have reinforced the importance of maintaining a complete and accurate IT asset inventory the foundation for vulnerability management, incident response, disaster recovery, and regulatory reporting.

To date, the platform has been maintained by team members as part of broader responsibilities. As its scope and strategic importance have grown, we now require dedicated expertise and capacity to maintain the platform, develop integrations with systems such as automated asset discovery, enhance workflows, and ensure ongoing data quality. A dedicated ITSM Platform Engineer will own this critical platform reducing operational risk, improving automation and efficiency, and ensuring the reliable asset and operational data needed to support regulatory expectations and our cybersecurity strategy.

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Jira Administrator / JSM Engineer to own the administration, configuration, governance, and ongoing support of Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. This role serves as the primary platform administrator responsible for designing and maintaining workflows, forms, automation, asset-management processes, service catalogs, reporting, and integrations that support Technology, Operations, Security, and Business teams across the enterprise. The ideal candidate combines strong technical administration skills with process expertise in Asset Management (Asset Inventory), Incident Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Agile delivery practices.

Key Responsibilities

Atlassian Platform Administration

  • Administer and maintain Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence.
  • Configure and manage projects, issue types, workflows, screens, custom fields, permissions, notification schemes, and security roles.
  • Maintain platform health, performance, reliability, and data integrity.
  • Implement platform governance standards, naming conventions, and configuration best practices.
  • Manage user provisioning, licensing, access controls, and security configurations.

Jira Service Management (JSM)

  • Configure and maintain JSM service desks, queues, request types, SLAs, customer portals, and service catalogs.
  • Design and enhance Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Request workflows.
  • Build and maintain incident, problem, change, release, and operational-support forms.
  • Configure approval workflows, escalation paths, notifications, and service-level management processes.
  • Partner with Production Support, Infrastructure, Security, and Application teams to optimize ITSM processes.

Assets & Configuration Management

  • Administer Jira Service Management Assets (CMDB).

title: Full Stack Developer - AI Products
jobDescription:
EIZEN AI

About Eizen AI
Eizen AI is an applied AI company building computer vision, video intelligence, and agentic AI systems for enterprises. We work with Fortune 500 organisations across manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and robotics, turning real-world video and operational data into decisions that run in production not in slide decks.
Our platform stack includes eizenOS, our video intelligence platform for large-scale perception and analytics, and eizenX, our agentic workflow design layer for building and orchestrating AI agents. Alongside these, our proprietary Dual Vision System combines ego-vision and exo-vision to give robotic and industrial systems a far richer operational understanding of their environment than single-viewpoint approaches allow.
Eizen operates from Hyderabad our primary R&D centre with a growing presence in Bengaluru and Atlanta, USA. We are a research-led team: our work sits at the intersection of self-supervised learning for video, visual symbol grounding, and production-grade AI engineering. The company was founded and is led by a PhD in Cognitive Robotics from IIT Kanpur, and our engineering culture reflects that deep technical ownership, first-principles problem solving, and an insistence that research ideas survive contact with production.
About This Role
Eizen is expanding its engineering team to support a major client engagement focused on building and scaling AI products. You will own full-stack product modules end to end React + TypeScript on the frontend, Python + FastAPI on the backend and the agentic AI layer that sits between them.
This is a genuinely full-stack role with an AI centre of gravity. Agent orchestration, tool execution, and retrieval pipelines are not a side project here; they are the product. That brings engineering problems most web teams never encounter: long-running multi-step workflows, non-deterministic model output, partial failures mid-execution, streaming responses, and retrieval quality that has to be measured rather than assumed. You will design for those conditions across the stack from the UI that streams a response to the worker that retries a failed tool call.
We are looking for an engineer who takes a module from architecture through production and stays accountable for it: contracts, data model, performance, tests, observability, and the go-get-things done behaviour.


What You'll Do
Frontend
Build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS with clear feature modules, routing, reusable components, and design-system patterns.
Implement real-time and streaming experiences using SSE and WebSockets for agent and LLM interactions.
¢ Implement state-management and caching strategies using React Query/SWR, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit.
¢ Drive frontend performance through code splitting, rendering optimisation, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals, and Lighthouse profiling.
¢ Apply accessibility standards and consistent, responsive UI patterns across the product.
Backend & APIs
¢ Develop and operate production backend services using Python and FastAPI.
¢ Design robust REST APIs with clear contracts, versioning, pagination, authentication and session handling, validation, and standardised error handling.
¢ Implement BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns to integrate frontend applications cleanly with backend and AI services.
¢ Integrate internal and external systems through REST APIs, third-party services, and microservice boundaries.
¢ Apply Python concurrency appropriately asyncio, thread pools, process pools with a clear view of the trade-offs.
Agentic AI & GenAI
¢ Design and build agentic AI and GenAI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, or comparable frameworks.
¢ Build AI agents, multi-step workflows, tool and function calling, and API integrations against OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude models.
¢ Build backend services for AI workflows covering orchestration, state management, tool execution, retries, timeouts, idempotency, and retrieval pipelines.
¢ Implement and tune RAG pipelines embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and reranking and measure retrieval quality rather than assume it.
¢ Apply prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioned, evaluated, and regression-tested.
Data & Databases
¢ Design data layers using PostgreSQL/MySQL schema design, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
¢ Build ETL and data-processing pipelines using Databricks and PySpark where the workload calls for it.
¢ Use Redis for caching, distributed coordination, and rate limiting.
Distributed Systems, Performance & Reliability
¢ Apply distributed systems patterns including queues and workers, retries with exponential backoff, DLQs, rate limiting, circuit breakers, and backpressure.
¢ Profile and optimise backend services, asynchronous workloads, database queries, and API response times.
¢ Build production observability using structured logs, metrics, tracing, and monitoring.
¢ Troubleshoot performance, integration, and production issues, and lead root-cause analysis.
Testing, Delivery & Collaboration
¢ Own frontend and backend testing strategy using React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest, Pytest, and Playwright.
¢ Integrate component, API, integration, and E2E tests into CI/CD pipelines, and keep flaky failures under control.
¢ Work with Docker, Kubernetes, environment and configuration management, and automated build/test/deploy pipelines.
¢ Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and release activities in an Agile/Scrum setting.
¢ Collaborate with product, design, AI/ML, DevOps, and QA to take features from architecture through production.
¢ Raise the bar on engineering discipline through code reviews, documentation, and mentoring.
Must-Have Skills
¢ 35 years of strong full-stack engineering experience with ownership of production applications.
¢ Strong production experience with React + TypeScript, including frontend architecture, refactoring, reusable components, and complex application development.
¢ Strong Python backend development experience, preferably with FastAPI.
¢ Experience designing and maintaining production REST APIs, including authentication, security, and third-party integration.
¢ Hands-on experience building AI/LLM or agentic applications agent frameworks, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines.
¢ Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL/MySQL, including data modelling, indexing, and query optimisation.
¢ Strong understanding of Python concurrency asyncio, thread pools, process pools and the associated performance trade-offs.
¢ Experience with Tailwind CSS at scale, including reusable UI primitives and consistent design patterns.
¢ Strong testing experience with React Testing Library and Playwright, including CI integration and flaky-test debugging.
¢ Experience with frontend and backend performance profiling and optimisation.
¢ Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals queues, workers, retries, resilience, and asynchronous processing.
¢ Experience with Git, Docker, environment management, deployment workflows, and CI/CD collaboration.

Nice to Have

¢ Experience with Next.js and BFF architecture in production.

¢ Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or large-scale data pipeline development.
¢ Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or similar messaging systems.

¢ Experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, or similar observability platforms.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent practical experience and a strong body of production work will be considered.
What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months
¢ You own one or more product modules end to end frontend, API, data model, and AI workflow and the team routes questions about them to you.
¢ Agent workflows behave predictably under failure: retries, timeouts, and idempotency are designed in rather than patched on.
¢ API contracts are stable and well-documented, and frontend integration no longer requires guesswork.
¢ Test coverage and CI signal are trusted, and flaky failures stop being background noise.
¢ Production issues are diagnosed from logs, metrics, and traces rather than reproduction attempts.
Why Join Eizen
